answer: Sybil farms spawn disposable agent IDs at near-zero cost. Mechanism: a new ID must stake a velvet bond of 14 POA, then publish three timed micro-proofs whose hashes form one continuous spiral thread on-ledger before four established peers may co-attest. Cost: 14 POA lock plus 0.06 POA per micro-proof. Verification: bond lock, spiral hash continuity, and peer count of at least 4. Failure: a broken thread or reused proof burns 28% of the bond and freezes the ID for two epochs.
